correctness.rationale: An explicit unitary two-bin four-point Fourier transform block-diagonalizes the real 8×9 Frobenius-orthonormal Hermitian lifting into rank-two DC, two rank-two lag-one, and rank-two Nyquist sectors. The singular values of each tiny block are elementary and their union proves the eight-value list. The largest/smallest comparisons, angular minimax plateau, and blow-up follow by strict nonnegative inequalities. Independent full-matrix SVD checks cover representative parameter regimes but the proof is analytic.

value.rationale: An exactly minimally sampled (eight intensities for three complex tones) practical Gaussian frequency-bin design has a complete noise-amplification law and sharp offset optimizer family, including a previously unquantified plateau and exact singular blow-up near grid alignment. These quantitative stability and experiment-design properties are stronger than the already known qualitative injectivity criterion.
